title: The Pluralistic Moral Gap: Understanding Judgment and Value Differences between Humans and Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on secular, real-world moral dilemmas and the values expressed in their justifications.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
